description: protocol.md 8 item 7: heads (one path each unless named), on a write holder, whose writes some cases need, with a read holder given the same records checked to show the same state at every step. Each case lists its records (labels, hashes, signed bytes, what they say) and every delivery or write with its outcome and the state after it: every path's heads in display order, the version at the path, deletion, conflict and conflict copies, the waiting records, the cursors and the next seq.
